note: Soldier, front view, spear held in the left (image-left) gauntleted fist. Head is the green helmet, the hair, the beard and the ears, bottom y~455 at the beard tip; the pink scarf, grey gorget and breastplate, belt, pouches, green fatigues and the purple cape panels at both sides are torso. Left arm is bent: green sleeve and bare skin make the upper arm (x345-402, y440-602) with the elbow at y~600 where the forearm turns left; the grey bracer is the forearm (x300-366, y505-592) to the wrist x~303; the dark grey gauntlet fist round the shaft (x240-303, y506-602) is the hand. The spear is equipment: the leaf-shaped head (tip at (198,60)), its socket, and the brown shaft above the fist (y288-507) and below it (y598-865), kept off the fist. Right arm hangs: green sleeve and bare skin are the upper arm to the elbow y~597 (material change to the bracer), the dark grey bracer is the forearm to y~648 and the dark rounded gauntlet fist below it with fingertips is the hand (y646-718). Hip is the fatigue hem (left y~790, right y~792); the bare skin strip below is thigh to the grey boot cuffs (left y808, right y812), which are above halfway so the knees; boot shafts are lower leg to the ankles (y~860), boot toes are feet.
